description: FedEx parcel rates for small packages (boxes, not pallets), US domestic ZIPs. Returns every FedEx option for the lane, cheapest first: each service level (Ground, Express Saver, 2Day, Overnight, ...) once per pickup type. pickup_type 'fedex_pickup' means FedEx collects at the pickup address; 'dropoff' means someone takes the package to a FedEx location. Show the user the options (including which are drop-off) and let them choose; book the chosen one with parcel_book. FedEx limits per package: 150 lb, longest side 108 in, length + girth 165 in. Pickup date must be within 10 days. Requires a signed-in Warp account.

packages.description: One entry per group of identical packages

name.description: Label for this package group, e.g. 'Box A'

quantity.description: Number of identical packages in this group

weight_lbs.description: Weight of ONE package, lb (FedEx limit 150 lb per package)
